cloud_credentials.title: iRobot cloud credentials (optional)
cloud_credentials.description:
All commands (start, stop, room selection) run locally over MQTT and never touch the cloud. Cloud credentials are only used to read room names, mission history, and favorites — the robot is always controlled directly.

Enter your iRobot app email and password to enable these cloud features, or leave both fields empty to use local MQTT only.

data_description.irobot_username: The email address used to log into the iRobot app.

data_description.host: The local IP address of the Roomba.
data_description.password: The robot password (hold HOME button to retrieve).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to iRobot cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Roomba+ could not authenticate with the iRobot cloud for "{name}" (currently: {current_user}). Local MQTT control keeps working regardless — this only affects cloud features (room names, mission history, favorites). Enter your current iRobot app email and password to reconnect.

data_description.irobot_username: The email address used to log into the iRobot app.

prime_account.title: Sign in with your iRobot account
prime_account.description: Works for any robot. Required for Combo/V4-generation models, which have no local setup — and the way to go for any robot whose password could not be found automatically. Enter your iRobot app email and password; this also discovers other robots on the same account.

abort.wrong_roombapy:
Roomba+ needs the asynchronous `roombapy` 2.x, and the copy Home Assistant has installed is an older one:

`{error}`

**Restart Home Assistant first** — that makes it install the version Roomba+ asks for.

If it comes back after a restart, Home Assistant's **built-in Roomba integration** is installing the older library over it. Both cannot be present: remove the built-in one (Settings → Devices & Services → Roomba → delete) and restart again. Roomba+ covers everything it does.

The Roomba+ version makes no difference here — every 4.2.x release needs the same library.

core_roomba_conflict.title: Two Roomba integrations installed
core_roomba_conflict.description:
Home Assistant's built-in **Roomba** integration is set up alongside Roomba+. Both use the same `roombapy` library, and Home Assistant installs only one copy of it — so one of the two will fail to load, usually with an `ImportError` in the log.

This is not something either integration can fix. Remove whichever one you do not need: Roomba+ covers everything the built-in one does and adds the newer cloud robots, but if you only have older robots and are happy with the built-in one, remove Roomba+ instead.

If you see `cannot import name 'Roomba' from 'roombapy'` in your log without having set the built-in one up, that is a different thing — see TROUBLESHOOTING.md, "Error occurred loading flow for integration roomba".

require_completed.description: When true, robot B starts only if robot A docked normally.

delay_minutes.name: Delay (minutes)
delay_minutes.description: Wait this many minutes after robot A docks before starting robot B.

create_backup.name: Create backup
create_backup.description: Export every persisted store for this robot into a single ZIP file.

restore_backup.name: Restore backup
restore_backup.description: Restore every store in a backup ZIP. Takes effect immediately, no restart required.

set_quiet_hours.name: Set quiet hours
set_quiet_hours.description: Write the household's Do Not Disturb window.

start.name: Start
start.description: When quiet hours begin each day.

end.name: End
end.description: When quiet hours end each day.

ends_at.name: Quiet until
ends_at.description: A single moment to stay quiet until, instead of a daily window.

clean_zone.name: Clean zone
clean_zone.description: Send a Prime robot to one or more clean zones on demand, by name or by numeric id.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: One or more zone names exactly as they appear on the map. Use this or zone id.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: One or more numeric zone ids. Use this or zone name.

rooms_not_found.message: Unknown room(s): {names}. Check the names match those assigned in Roomba+ options.

rooms_different_floors.message: All rooms must be on the same floor. Got rooms from different maps: {pmap_ids}.

not_smart_map.message: Room cleaning requires a robot with a finalized Smart Map (i7, s9, j-series, or Braava jet m6). This robot has no Smart Map — if it is a compatible model, make sure its map is saved in the iRobot app.

no_rooms_configured.message: No rooms configured yet. To use this action: (1) Open the iRobot app, (2) Start a room-targeted clean for each room, (3) Return to Home Assistant — the rooms will appear automatically in the Roomba+ options where you can assign names.

pmap_not_resolved.message: Could not resolve map ID for one or more rooms. Ensure the robot has reported its map state via MQTT.

map_updating.message: The robot is currently updating its Smart Map. Wait for the readiness sensor to show 'Ready', then try again.

entity_not_found.message: Entity {entity_id} not found in the entity registry.

maintenance_store_unavailable.message: Maintenance store is not available for {entity_id}. Reload the integration and try again.

no_valid_segments.message: No segments matched the current map. The map may have been retrained — re-run a room mission in the iRobot app to refresh the room layout.

config_entry_not_found.message: No config entry found for {entity_id}. Try reloading the integration.

room_name_and_room_passes_conflict.message: Provide either room_name or room_passes, not both.

no_rooms_resolved.message: No rooms to clean — provide at least one room name.

backup_entity_not_found.message: The entity "{entity_id}" could not be resolved to a Roomba+ robot. Check the entity ID and try again.

dock_operation_in_progress.message: The dock is busy {operation}. The robot will not act on commands until it finishes.

quiet_hours_incomplete.message: Quiet hours need both a start and an end, or neither.

quiet_hours_ambiguous.message: Give either a daily window (start and end) or a one-off quiet-until moment — the robot accepts exactly one of the two.

quiet_hours_not_prime.message: {entity} is not a V4/Prime robot with a household.

prime_not_connected.message: This robot has no cloud connection.

cloud_required.message: Room targeting needs iRobot cloud credentials on this robot. Add them in the integration options, or clean the whole house instead.

calendar_room_not_found.message: No room matched "{text}". Name a room in the event's summary, description or location — known rooms: {known}. Leave all three free of room names for a whole-house clean.

zone_name_and_zone_id_conflict.message: Provide either zone_name or zone_id, not both.

zone_name_not_found.message: One or more zone names were not found on the map.

favorite_needs_cloud.message: Favourites are stored in your iRobot account, so this needs cloud credentials. Add them in the integration options and the favourites will appear.

no_zone_selected.message: No room is selected. Pick one in the zone selector first.

no_room_cleaning.message: This robot has no room cleaning support.

room_name_is_a_zone.message: {names} is a zone rather than a room on this robot. Use roomba_plus.clean_zone with the same name.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Roomba+ robot for {entity_id} is not loaded right now. Check that its integration entry is enabled and set up, then try again.

roombapy_too_old.message: Roomba+ needs the asynchronous roombapy 2.x, but an older version is installed ({error}). Restart Home Assistant. If this persists, Home Assistant's built-in Roomba integration is reinstalling the old library and needs to be removed.

cannot_connect_local.message: Cannot connect to the robot at {host}.

prime_login_rejected.message: The iRobot cloud rejected the login for robot {blid}: {error}

prime_login_failed.message: Could not log in to the iRobot cloud for robot {blid}: {error}

all_day_not_schedulable.message: All-day events cannot become schedules — a robot needs a time of day to start at.

no_robot_schedule.message: This robot does not report a schedule, so there is nothing to write to.

schedule_occurrence_not_editable.message: A robot schedule has no single occurrence to change — every run comes from the same weekly entry.

schedule_entry_unknown.message: That schedule entry cannot be identified on the robot.

rrule_not_supported.message: This robot cannot express '{rrule}'. It supports weekly, every two weeks, monthly and one-off schedules. For anything else, use the roomba_plus.create_schedule action.

schedule_change_rejected.message: The robot schedule could not be changed: {reason}

command_not_delivered.message: The '{command}' command was not accepted for delivery — it never reached iRobot's cloud, so the robot has not seen it. This is a connection problem, not a refusal by the robot.

prime_shadows_unavailable.message: Could not read any state from the iRobot cloud for robot {blid}: {error}

schedules_unreadable.message: Could not read the schedules from the iRobot cloud — nothing was written.

prime_cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to robot {blid} through the iRobot cloud: {error}

parts_unreadable.message: Could not read the consumable parts from the iRobot cloud: {error}

not_a_prime_robot.message: {entity_id} is not a cloud (V4/Prime) robot. These actions manage iRobot cloud schedules and need one.

not_a_schedule_switch.message: {entity_id} is not a schedule switch. Target the schedule's own switch entity.

schedule_container_gone.message: The schedule group for {schedule_id} no longer exists.

no_schedule_template.message: This household has no existing schedule to derive from. Create one in the iRobot app first — the cloud refuses schedules built from scratch.

schedule_gone.message: That schedule no longer exists on the robot — it may have been deleted in the iRobot app. Reload the integration to catch up.

schedule_id_gone.message: Schedule {schedule_id} no longer exists on the robot.

schedule_time_required.message: A time is required, because the schedule used as a template has none.

schedule_changed_meanwhile.message: Schedule {schedule_id} disappeared while it was being changed — another app probably deleted it. Nothing was written.

room_list_not_read.message: The room list has not been read yet, so the map each room belongs to is unknown.

room_map_unknown.message: The map these rooms belong to is not known yet, so a room clean cannot be sent — sending it anyway would start a whole-house clean. Wait for the map to load, or start the robot without naming rooms.

rooms_on_different_maps.message: Those rooms are on different maps. One cleaning command can only target one map, so clean them separately.

current_map_unknown.message: This robot has {count} maps and is not reporting which one it is on, so it is unclear which floor's rooms you mean. Start the robot from the iRobot app first, or wait until it has relocalised.

no_saved_maps.message: This robot has no saved maps yet, so it cannot clean a named room. Let it finish a full mapping run first.

not_an_account_map.message: {option} is not one of this account's maps.

no_mission_history.message: There is no mission history for {entity_id} yet.

backup_corrupt.message: The backup file is damaged or not a ZIP file: {path}

backup_invalid.message: Not a valid Roomba+ backup (manifest.json is missing): {path}

not_a_suction_level.message: {fan_speed} is not one of this robot's suction levels.

send_command_prime_unsupported.message: send_command is not supported for cloud (V4/Prime) robots yet. Use the standard vacuum actions instead (start, pause, stop, return to base, locate).

cloud_part_reset_unavailable.message: Resetting this part is recorded with iRobot's cloud, and the cloud connection is not available. Nothing was reset.

cloud_part_unknown.message: iRobot's cloud does not list the part {part} for this robot, so its counter cannot be reset there.

cloud_part_reset_failed.message: iRobot's cloud did not reset the counter ({error}). The local counter was left unchanged; try again later.

cloud_part_reset_not_confirmed.message: iRobot's cloud accepted the request but did not confirm the reset. The local counter was left unchanged.

no_confirmed_room.message: No learned room is confirmed yet. Rooms are learned from completed missions; run a few more.

no_last_mission.message: The robot has not reported a previous cleaning command to repeat.

favorite_has_no_commands.message: The favourite {name} contains no commands to run.
